In a galaxy far, far away, the Lego Movie universe is in crisis. The evil Lord Business has taken over and the legendary Master Builders are in hiding. These Master Builders, a group of Lego minifigures, have the ability to build anything without instructions. It is said that they meet in the "Dog" part of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various issues.

Meanwhile, on Earth, a group of individuals are tasked with investigating a failed IT system implementation at the Post Office. The inquiry includes the establishment of a website and premises, and sets out terms of reference. The statement includes two main points: A) Understand and acknowledge what went wrong and the key lessons that must be learned, and B) Obtain all available relevant evidence from the Post Office, Fujitsu, BEIS and other relevant organizations.
